nodes.label: Dependabot Configuration
nodes.rationale: Weekly grouped updates for pip (agent/core), cargo (vestad), npm (apps), and github-actions. Expo SDK owns the versions of its managed packages (react, react-native, expo, typescript), so those are ignored; eslint majors are ignored because eslint-config-expo pins the lint stack to the SDK matrix and majors only yield red PRs (#1380).
